correctness.rationale: An edge consumes exactly the 2r colors, so the supports must be complementary and all choices of signs in the two shores are allowed. There are no 2-simplices. With edges oriented from one shore to the other, integral cycles are precisely matrices with zero row and column sums, freely generated by outer products of differences from two chosen basepoints. This gives the ranks and the negative transpose sign for a shore exchange. On each shore the (C₂)^r action is regular; for its augmentation ideal J the coinvariant relations generate J², and g↦g−1 mod J² identifies the quotient with the abelianization, with inverse ∑n_g g↦∑n_g[g]. The two independent shore actions give the tensor product of these elementary two-groups, hence r² copies per component. Permuting colors is transitive on the resulting basis labels (partition and one coordinate per shore), and the reversal sign disappears mod 2, leaving exactly one copy. On each geometric component an oriented barycentric edge parameter identifies the flip quotient with an interval: edge transitivity has no edge reversals under flips. The full action also identifies complementary parameter values, leaving an interval again, not a loop.
residual_risks: No claim is assessed for larger color counts, other primes, or higher degrees.

originality.rationale: A decisive earlier Resultary theorem for the very same critical 2r-part join gives the exact integral equivariant module for arbitrary part sizes, explicitly including the cross-polytope. Its action is the one needed here, not merely a rational character or an ordinary homology rank. Both claimed coinvariant formulas, including their ranks and the sign under reversal, follow directly by specialization and standard coinvariant identities. The formulas need not already be printed verbatim to be covered. The quotient contrast likewise follows from the previously described natural graph action.

value.rationale: The integral coinvariants versus geometric quotient distinction is a useful illustration, and the invariant is natural. But the full integral symmetry module for this family had already been obtained: the difference is recovered by the routine augmentation-ideal formula and a single transitive permutation orbit. The quotient interval calculation is equally immediate from the earlier natural graph action. There is no surviving nonmechanical mathematical claim in this record; the extra finite Smith computations corroborate the illustration rather than supply such a claim.
residual_risks: The pedagogical usefulness of this worked example is not disputed; it is not a distinct research finding.
